_comment: ozow-payment-provider mission, M2/F2 (checkout wiring). Pins the exact wire shapes @dev must produce, so @qa can diff observed responses against fixed values rather than re-deriving them. See README.md in this directory for the full decision record.

exports.resolveProvider: (id: string) => PaymentProvider | null — null for ANY id not a hasOwnProperty key of paymentProviders, never a thrown error, never a fallback provider

registry.replaces: export const paymentProvider: PaymentProvider = payfastProvider; — this single-const export is REMOVED, not kept alongside the registry as a deprecated alias (every caller must move to resolveProvider/paymentProviders)

newField.name: providerId

bodyShape.error: string, MUST mention 'providerId' (case-insensitive substring match) so it is distinguishable from the pre-existing showId/lineItems 400

newField.validationMustRunBefore: the `if (!client)` Sanity-configured guard — see contracts/checks/ozow-m1-f2/check-providerid-fail-closed.mjs, whose offline proof depends on this exact ordering

orderDocument.priorBehaviour: always the module constant PAYFAST_GATEWAY ('payfast'), regardless of any input — a real defect this feature fixes, see contracts/checks/ozow-m1-f2/check-gateway-threading.mjs
orderDocument.requiredBehaviour: equal to the resolved providerId ('payfast' or 'ozow') that checkout/route.ts validated and used for the actual gateway hand-off — never re-derived, never re-guessed

threadedVia.BuildMultiReservationDocsInput.gateway: string, required, new field — THIS is the one checkout/route.ts's reserveTicket() actually calls in production; buildReservationDocs()'s sibling fix alone would NOT have covered the live call path

payfastRoute.mustStayAt: this exact path — Ozow's own account has nothing to do with this constraint; PayFast's live sandbox NotifyUrl is already registered against it

sharedHelper.rejectedShape: one shared route resolving the provider from a query param (?provider=ozow) or a [provider] dynamic path segment — see contracts/checks/ozow-m1-f2/check-notification-routing-shape.sh part (g)

notificationRouting.landmarkOrderReuse: the extracted helper's internal step order is verified by RE-RUNNING the existing contracts/checks/payment-seam-f2/check-sequence-and-ownership.sh with ITN_PATH_OVERRIDE=lib/tickets-notification.ts — that script already supports a path override (built for check-ordering-mutations.sh) and its 11-landmark assertion applies unchanged to wherever the logic now lives
